chars.SALIM: SALIM: an 18-year-old young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one white chest stripe, black jogger trousers and white sneakers.
chars.FRIEND: FRIEND: a young man wearing a green varsity jacket with white sleeves, a grey t-shirt and blue jeans.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young woman wearing a lilac oversized knit sweater, light-blue wide jeans, white sneakers and a small black shoulder bag.
chars.DJ: DJ: a young man wearing a black baseball cap backwards, a white oversized t-shirt and big black headphones around his neck.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a rich family villa living room in Hay Riad, Rabat, Morocco, in the evening (Moroccan salon with sedari sofas, carpet, a big framed family portrait of a stern father on the wall). FRIEND excitedly carries a huge party loudspeaker into the salon and grins, while SALIM stands in front of him with both hands up, nervously looking back over his shoulder at the stern father's portrait on the wall. Comic tension between the two.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night, the front door of the same Moroccan villa is wide open and a crowd of teenagers in casual party clothes pours inside; SALIM stands holding the door, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise at how many people are coming.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The Moroccan salon turned into a party: DJ stands behind a small DJ table with laptop and mixer, pumping one fist, colorful party lights on the walls; SALIM next to him laughing and pointing at the dance floor.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Two huge black loudspeakers in the corners of the Moroccan salon, a crowd of teenagers dancing between them under purple and blue party lights, FRIEND in the middle jumping with both arms in the air, plastic cups on the low table.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SALIM stands proudly in the middle of the party in the Moroccan salon with a big happy smile, FRIEND and several teenagers around him patting his shoulders and giving him high fives, party lights.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: A circle of teenagers at the party clapping and cheering for SALIM, who stands in the center blushing and waving shyly, Moroccan salon with sedari sofas and colorful lights.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At the edge of the party near the salon doorway, GIRL walks up to SALIM with a flirty smile and a little wave, SALIM freezes awkwardly holding a plastic cup, surprised and shy, other dancing teenagers blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the Moroccan villa, GIRL leads SALIM by the hand up a marble staircase toward the dark upper floor, she looks back at him smiling, SALIM follows with a nervous excited face; the party crowd and colorful lights are below at the bottom of the stairs.
